image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light mounted against a light-colored building facade. The traffic light housing is black with three circular signal lenses stacked vertically. Each lens has a prominent cylindrical visor (hood) extending outward. The top lens appears to have a reddish tint, the middle an amber/yellowish tint, and the bottom is dark/reflective. The background shows architectural details of a building with windows and stone/concrete textures.
